from.place: General cohomological continuity used after constructing the punctured inverse system: sections on quasi-compact opens are represented and identified at a finite stage.

title: Sections of a sheaf system on a spectral inverse limit descend to a finite stage
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed set. Let $X_i$ be spectral spaces [def-weil-spectral-space], and let $f_{ij}:X_j\to X_i$ for $i\le j$ be continuous maps such that inverse images of quasi-compact opens are quasi-compact, $f_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $f_{ij}\circ f_{jk}=f_{ik}$. Let $X$ be their inverse limit in topological spaces, with projections $p_i:X\to X_i$: its points are the compatible tuples, and its topology is the coarsest making every $p_i$ continuous. For every $i$ let $F_i$ be a sheaf of abelian groups on $X_i$, with morphisms $\alpha_{ij}:F_i\to(f_{ij})_*F_j$ satisfying $\alpha_{ii}=\mathrm{id}$ and $\alpha_{ik}=(f_{ij})_*\alpha_{jk}\circ\alpha_{ij}$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]. Put $F=\varinjlim_i p_i^{-1}F_i$ in abelian sheaves on $X$, using the pullbacks of the adjoints $f_{ij}^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ as transition maps [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every $i$ and every quasi-compact open $U_i\subseteq X_i$, the canonical map induced by pullback of sections and the colimit coprojections is an isomorphism of abelian groups: $$\varinjlim_{j\ge i} F_j(f_{ij}^{-1}U_i)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(p_i^{-1}U_i).$$ The transition homomorphism from index $j$ to $k\ge j$ on the left is the component of $\alpha_{jk}$ over $f_{ij}^{-1}U_i$, with $f_{jk}^{-1}f_{ij}^{-1}U_i=f_{ik}^{-1}U_i$.
